column1: # Display assignments for the recognition manuscript
# (mf_recognition_complexity.tex).
# key<TAB>status<TAB>decls<TAB>note.  Generated companion:
# metadata/MF_RECOGNITION_DISPLAY_CENSUS.tsv, which must not be edited.  The
# key is printed by scripts/display_census.py: for a display block it is the
# first twelve hex digits of the sha256 of the normalized block body, and for a
# line the prose \eqref's individually it is the sha256 of the LABEL, so that
# rewording such a line does not move its row.
# Statuses:
#   carrier               the named declarations state this displayed identity
#   notation-only         the display introduces a symbol the prose names; it
#                         asserts nothing, and decls name the defined object
#   derivation-of:<key>   an intermediate step of a proof whose conclusion is
#                         graded at that SENTENCE key.  Such a row names NO
#                         declarations, and the target must resolve in the
#                         recognition sentence census and must not itself be
#                         unassigned.
# A key with no row here reads `unassigned`, the state --check rejects.
# Opened 2026-08-29 by census-lane for issue #51's display subtask, empty on
# purpose: the recognition displays are untriaged, and the external audit
# singles out the compiler section's seed table as the one that most needs a
# grade.  The workflow runs regeneration, --verify-links and --verify-decls,
# and not --check, so the count of what is ungraded is reported rather than
# turned into a permanent red.
